name: license-checker
description: Warns when a dependency with a copyleft license (GPL, AGPL) lands in a permissively licensed project.

projectLicense.title: Project license
projectLicense.description: SPDX name of your project's license (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause ...). Leave empty to read it from package.json, pyproject.toml or a LICENSE file.

allowedPackages.title: Allowed packages
allowedPackages.description: Comma-separated package names that are never flagged, for example a LGPL library you have already reviewed.

checkDev.title: Check dev dependencies
checkDev.description: Also check packages installed as dev dependencies (-D, --dev). They are not shipped with your code, so this is off by default.

timeoutMs.title: Lookup timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the npm registry or PyPI before giving up on a package.
